Definition: from a compound of G1722 and G5028; to inswathe with cerements for interment:--bury.
BiblicalUsage: To wrap a body for burial. They wound Jesus' body in linen with spices, as the manner of the Jews is to bury, in John 19:40, and Mary poured ointment on His body for His burial in Matthew 26:12.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the burial matters because the resurrection needed a real grave — He was truly dead, truly buried, and truly raised.
